description_en: Calls the GetImage operation to get image information from a media set
description_zh: 调用GetImage接口从媒体集中获取一张图片的信息
kebab_example: aliyun imm get-image --project immimagetest --set-id set001 --image-uri oss://imm-test/testcases/face1.jpg --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetImage

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the media set
parameters.name: set_id

parameters.help_en:
The OSS URI of the image.

The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of the OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
图片的OSS URI。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: image_uri

Address.description_en:
The image geolocation detection result.

The detection result has a value only when the image contains geolocation information
Address.description_zh:
图片地理位置检测结果。

只有图片中包含地理位置信息时，检测结果才有值

AddressLine.description_en: The full address of the image geolocation
AddressLine.description_zh: 图片地理位置的完整地址
AddressLine.example: 中国浙江省杭州市西湖区转塘街道石龙山西路

City.description_en: The city (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
City.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在城市（或同级）

Country.description_en: The country or region of the image geolocation
Country.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在国家或地区

District.description_en: The district (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
District.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在区（或同级）

Province.description_en: The province (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
Province.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在省（或同级）

Township.description_en: The street (or equivalent level) of the image geolocation
Township.description_zh: 图片地理位置所在街道（或同级）

AddressFailReason.description_en:
The failure reason for image geolocation detection.

This parameter has a value only when image geolocation detection fails
AddressFailReason.description_zh:
图片地理位置检测的失败原因。

只有当图片地理位置检测失败时，此参数才有值

AddressModifyTime.description_en: The update time of image geolocation detection
AddressModifyTime.description_zh: 图片地理位置检测的更新时间

AddressStatus.description_en:
The status of image geolocation detection, including the following options:

NotProcessed: not processed
Processing: being processed
Success: succeeded
Failed: failed

You can decide whether to read the result, wait, or retry based on this status
AddressStatus.description_zh:
图片地理位置检测的状态，包括如下选项：

NotProcessed：未处理
Processing：处理中
Success：成功
Failed：失败

您可以根据该状态决定读取结果、等待或重试

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the image was added to the media set
CreateTime.description_zh: 图片加入媒体集的时间

CroppingSuggestion.description_en: The cropping suggestions for the image

Height.description_en: The height of the cropping bounding box. Unit: px

Left.description_en: The X-coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the left. Unit: px
Left.description_zh: 顶点X坐标，距离左端距离。单位为px

Top.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the top. Unit: px
Top.description_zh: 顶点Y坐标，距离顶端距离。单位为px

Width.description_en: The width of the cropping bounding box. Unit: px

Score.description_en: The aesthetic score of the cropping scheme. A higher score indicates a better result. The value ranges from 0 to 1
Score.description_zh: 该裁剪方案的美学分数，分数越高表示该方案效果越好，取值范围为0～1

CroppingSuggestionFailReason.description_en:
The failure reason for the cropping suggestion.

This parameter has a value only when the cropping suggestion fails
CroppingSuggestionFailReason.description_zh:
裁剪建议提供失败的原因。

只有当图片裁剪建议提供失败时，此参数才有值

CroppingSuggestionModifyTime.description_en: The time of the latest cropping suggestion
CroppingSuggestionModifyTime.description_zh: 提供最新裁剪建议的时间

CroppingSuggestionStatus.description_en:
The status of the cropping suggestion, including the following options:

NotProcessed: not processed
Processing: being processed
Success: succeeded
Failed: failed

You can decide whether to read the result, wait, or retry based on this status
CroppingSuggestionStatus.description_zh:
提供裁剪建议的状态，包括如下选项：

NotProcessed：未处理
Processing：处理中
Success：成功
Failed：失败

您可以根据该状态决定读取结果、等待或重试

Exif.description_en: The original EXIF information of the image, stored in serialized JSON object format
Exif.description_zh: 图片原始EXIF信息，以JSON Object序列化后的格式存储

ExternalId.description_en: The external ID, which is used to bind with the ID in your application layer, if any
ExternalId.description_zh: 外部ID，用于和您的应用层的ID（如果有）进行绑定

Attractive.description_en: The face attractiveness. A higher score indicates greater attractiveness. The value ranges from 0 to 1
Attractive.description_zh: 人脸吸引力，分数越高吸引力越强，取值范围为0~1

EmotionDetails.description_en: The confidence for seven types of emotions
EmotionDetails.description_zh: 七种心情对应的置信度

ANGRY.description_en: The confidence for the ANGRY emotion

CALM.description_en: The confidence for the CALM emotion

DISGUSTED.description_en: The confidence for the DISGUSTED emotion

HAPPY.description_en: The confidence for the HAPPY emotion

SAD.description_en: The confidence for the SAD emotion

SCARED.description_en: The confidence for the SCARED emotion

SURPRISED.description_en: The confidence for the SURPRISED emotion

BeardConfidence.description_en: The confidence of whether a beard is present

Height.description_en: The height of the face bounding box. Unit: px

Left.description_en: The X-coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the left. Unit: px
Left.description_zh: 顶点X坐标，距离左端距离。单位为px

Top.description_en: The Y-coordinate of the top-left vertex, which is the distance from the top. Unit: px
Top.description_zh: 顶点Y坐标，距离顶端距离。单位为px

Width.description_en: The width of the face bounding box. Unit: px

GlassesConfidence.description_en: The confidence of whether glasses are worn

Pitch.description_en: The pitch angle of the face. The value ranges from `-180 to +180` degrees. The recommended reliable range is `-30 to +30` degrees
Pitch.description_zh: 人脸的俯仰角，取值范围为`-180～+180`度，可信的范围建议为`-30～+30`度

Roll.description_en: The roll angle. The value ranges from `-180 to +180` degrees. The recommended reliable range is `-45 to +45` degrees
Roll.description_zh: 内偏转角，取值范围为`-180～+180`度，可信的建议范围为`-45～+45`度

Yaw.description_en: The yaw angle of the face. The value ranges from `-180 to +180` degrees. The recommended reliable range is `-80 to +80` degrees
Yaw.description_zh: 人脸的左右偏转角，取值范围为`-180～+180`度，可信的范围建议为`-80～+80`度

MaskConfidence.description_en: The confidence of whether a mask is worn

Gender.description_en: The gender. Valid values: MALE and FEMALE

GroupId.description_en: The face group ID. If the face is not grouped, the return value of this parameter is group-not-grouped
GroupId.description_zh: 人脸分组ID。如果人脸未分组，则此参数返回值为group-not-grouped

FacesFailReason.description_en:
The failure reason for face recognition.

This parameter has a value only when face recognition fails
FacesFailReason.description_zh:
人脸识别的失败原因。

只有当人脸识别失败时，此参数才有值

FacesModifyTime.description_en: The update time of face recognition

FacesStatus.description_en:

ImageTime.description_en:
The capture date of the image, obtained from EXIF information.

If the image EXIF information does not contain this field, this parameter is not included in the response
ImageTime.description_zh:
图片的拍摄日期，该日期从EXIF信息中获取。

如果图片EXIF信息无此信息，则返回结果中无此参数

ImageUri.description_en: The OSS URI of the image

Location.description_en:
The image geolocation, obtained from EXIF information. The format is `lat,long`, which consists of floating-point numbers separated by a comma (,).

If the image EXIF information does not contain this field, this parameter is not included in the response
Location.description_zh:
图片地理位置，从EXIF信息中获取，格式为`lat,long`，以英文逗号（,）分隔的浮点数。

如果图片EXIF信息无此信息，则返回结果中无此参数

ModifyTime.description_en:
The modification time of the image.

After adding the image, if the image has not been modified, the modification time is the same as the creation time of the image
ModifyTime.description_zh:
图片的修改时间。

添加图片后，如果未修改过图片，则图片的修改时间和图片的创建时间相同

Height.description_zh: 文字位置框高度。单位为px

Left.description_zh: 顶点X坐标，距离左端距离。单位为px

Width.description_en: The width of the text bounding box. Unit: px
Width.description_zh: 文字位置框宽度。单位为px

The image orientation value, obtained from EXIF information.

If the image EXIF information does not contain this field, this parameter is not included in the response

图片旋转值，从EXIF信息中获取。

如果图片EXIF信息无此信息，则返回结果中无此参数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID of the current request

SetId.description_en: The unique identifier of the media set

SourcePosition.description_en:
This parameter takes effect only when SourceType is video.

The position of the image frame on the timeline of the source video. The format is `00000000.010`, which is %8.3f
SourcePosition.description_zh:
只有当SourceType为video时，此参数才生效。

视频中该图片帧处于源视频的时间轴位置。格式为`00000000.010`，即%8.3f

SourceType.description_en: The type of the source data

SourceUri.description_en: The OSS URI of the image

CentricScore.description_en: The tag centric score. It indicates how prominent the tag content is in the image. A higher score indicates that the tag is more likely to be the main subject of the image. The value ranges from 0 to 1
CentricScore.description_zh: 标签主体分数。用于提示该标签内容在图片中的主要程度，越高则说明该标签越可能为图片主体。取值范围为0~1

TagLevel.description_en: The tag level. The value ranges from 1 to 4

TagsFailReason.description_en:
The failure reason for tag recognition. The format is `[HTTPStatusCode ErrorCode] ErrorMessage`, for example, `[400 InvalidResource] Specified resource is too large. Please check.`

This parameter has a value only when tag recognition fails
TagsFailReason.description_zh:
标签识别的失败原因。格式为`[HTTPStatusCode ErrorCode] ErrorMessage`，例如`[400 InvalidResource] Specified resource is too large. Please check.`

只有当标签识别失败时，此参数才有值

TagsModifyTime.description_en: The update time of tag recognition. Updated when TagsStatus changes
TagsModifyTime.description_zh: 标签识别的更新时间。当TagsStatus更改时更新

TagsStatus.description_en:
The status of tag recognition, including the following options:

NotProcessed: not processed
Processing: being processed
Success: succeeded
Failed: failed

You can decide whether to read the result, wait, or retry based on this status
